subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: After the state-boundary defects are repaired, should Usage & Spend remain a dedicated Settings pane or be integrated into the existing Overview surface?
rationale: Both placements are technically viable, and the repository owner must choose the permanent navigation and information architecture for this new product surface.

options.title: Keep dedicated pane
options.body: Retain the submitted persistent dashboard as a focused exploration surface with its own saved selection.

options.title: Integrate into Overview
options.body: Reuse the dashboard model within Overview to avoid adding another permanent Settings destination.

recommendation.title: Keep dedicated pane
recommendation.body: Retain the submitted persistent dashboard as a focused exploration surface with its own saved selection.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the repository, authored the rewritten branch commits, and is the person directly asked for the product-placement decision.
